tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las: phrin las lam khyer bsdus pa me tog phreng mdzes bzhugs so:

na mo gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī hūm̐: dgongs 'dus kha skong las byang mdor bsdus shing: phyi rabs don du tshogs gnyis gsag phyir brjod: dkyil 'khor gtor mchod bkod pa'i bye brag dang: bgegs gtor btang ste bka' bsgo mtshams gcod gyer: yan lag bdun pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya: mchod gtor sman raka bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab: ting 'dzin gsum gsal gzhal yas lha tshogs bskyed: spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dbang bskur rgyas gdab cing: phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka sbreng: gtor 'bul bstod pa tshogs kyi yo byad bsham: bsang sbyang byin brlab tshogs gyer bskang gso bya: lhag ma 'dzab bskul gang 'dod las sbyor 'bad: chad mdo brtan ma bskyangs nas rta bro brdung: dngos grub blangs la bshags pa bkra shis brjod: dal bsdu dmigs med rgyas gdab bsngo ba bya: bsdus don rkang grangs rim pa e ma ho: lha bsgrub dkyil 'khor bri 'am tshom bu bkod: 'byor tshogs gtor ma bag dro rgyan ldan dang: phyi nang mchod sogs sman rag g.yas g.yon bsham: gzhan yang bla ma yi dam ḍā ki yi: sku gsung thugs rten dkon mchog mchod sprin rnams: bkod pa'i bye brag /mchan/ mdzes shing yid 'ong bag dro bkram par bya: de nas bgegs dang 'byung po'i gtor ma ni: 'bras chen bshos chang ting lo mar me bsham: 1$0000250oṃ āḥhūm̐ 1$0000300 gis byin brlabs ci 'dod dmigs: rang nyid dbang chen rta mgrin 'bar bar bskyed: rta skad sgrog cing bgegs 'dul ngar ldan gsal: bka' bsgo ni: hūm̐ hrī: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi bka' byung zhing: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i pho brang 'debs 'tshal bas: 'dod yon mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la: khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: gal te mi 'gro bka' las 'da' byed na: bdag nyid khro rgyal dbang chen rab khros nas:

lus sems ma lus brlag par gdon mi za: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bigha nān: na ma: sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya: sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛ h+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā: sarba bigha nān gats+tsha: oṃ suṃ bha ni phaṭa: ha ya grī wa hūm̐: mtshams gcod: hūm̐ hrī: ye shes rol pa dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: ye nas rnam dag lha yi rang bzhin la: bdud bgegs log 'dren bar chad ming yang med: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī shu dz+nyā na ma hā rak+ṣaṃ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: yan lag bdun pa: kye: phyogs bcu'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog bdag la dgongs: 'gro rnams skyob pa'i mgon dang dpung mdzod cig: dus 'di nas bzung rdzogs sangs ma rgyas bar: mgon po mchog gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod mchod par 'bul: nyams chag nyes ltung bsags rnams mthol zhing bshags: dus gsum dge bar gyur la rjes yi rang: bla med theg chen chos 'khor bskor du gsol: rgyal ba mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol: bdag gzhan dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo: skyabs 'gro: skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnams la skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed: sngon chad rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rmad byung ltar: de bzhin bdag gis dus 'di nas brtsam bya: 'gro ba yongs kyi bla mar bdag gyur cig: mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab: oṃ: snang srid 'dod yon longs spyod mchod pa'i rdzas: ā: rnam dag lha tshogs dgyes pa skong bar byed: hūm̐: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya nus bcud ldan: hoḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bla na med: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wid+yā shab+da ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da ghan+dhe rā sa spar+she ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti ba su ta tsit+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐:

bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu ā: bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab: ā+oṃ: bhan+dha khor yug bdud rtsi'i snod chen por: dug lnga dbyings sgrol rang byung ye shes rdzas: zag med bde chen lhun grub bdud rtsir 'khyil: lha rnams dgyes pa skong ba'i bcud du gyur: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: rak+ta byin gyis brlab: āḥ dbyings kyi rang bzhin stong nyid ka pā lar: ye shes chen po bde ba'i rak+ta mchog: dbyings dang ye shes bde stong dmar 'od 'dres: khu ba rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: gtor ma byin gyis brlab: hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten yangs pa'i gzhong pa ru: bcud kyi skye 'gro ba liṃ chen por sbyar: rgyu rkyen rten 'brel nus pas byin brlabs nas: kun rdzob mtshan ma'i bag chags skyon dang bral: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā ba liṃ ta bha ta ba liṃ te swā hā: ā+oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di dag dang: sman gtor rak+ta gtor mar bcas pa rnams: ye nas rang byung dag par lhun grub phyir: bsang sbyang byin rlabs mtshan ma'i mtha' las 'das: 'on kyang kun rdzob sgyu ma'i bag chags rnams: rnam 'phrul rol pas bsangs shing byin gyis brlabs: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes me yis nyon mongs bag chags bsreg: skyod byed rlung gis mtshan 'dzin bag rdul gtor: dag byed chu yis kun rdzob dri ma bkru: bsregs gtor bkrus pas rtog pa'i skyon dang bral: raṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: yaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: khaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: ā+oṃ ni spel byed sku yi yig 'brur gsal: āḥni sbyong byed gsung gi yig 'brur gsal: hūm̐ ni sgyur byed thugs kyi yig 'brur gsal: dpag med rnam dag ye shes chen por gyur: sku gsung thugs mchog oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ gis: snod bcud rgyu rkyen rten 'brel nus mthur ldan:

ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: ting 'dzin rnam gsum las: dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐ hrī: snang srid 'khor 'das gnyis bsdus chos rnams kun: stong zhing bdag med nam mkha' lta bu la: byed spyod blang dor 'dzin pa'i mtha' las 'das: de bzhin nyid du pad+ma rgyal pos smra: ā+oṃ ma hā shū dz+nyā tā dz+nyā na swa bhā wa hūm̐: kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin ni: de ltar ma rtogs 'khrul par gyur pa yi: ltar snang skye 'gro'i 'gro ba nyon re mongs: bzod med gdung ba'i blo yis rab bzung ste: kun snang tsam du bdag gis bsgral bar bgyi: dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa hūm̐: rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hrī: don dam dbyings las 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul shar: sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar byed glog ltar 'khyug: rgyu yi he ru dmar gsal me 'od 'phro: thugs rje'i zhal phyag rnam 'gyur bsam mi khyab: tsit+ta pad+ma badz+ra hūm̐: gzhal yas khang bskyed pa: bh+rūm̐: 'byung ba me rlung 'khrugs pa'i pho brang dbus: zla gam dmar chen 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du: gdal khyab pags pas rab g.yogs keng rus mkhar: sha khrag phung po 'dus pa'i gzhal yas khang: dbang po sgo bzhi nyi zla'i skar khung can: yan lag rta babs skra yi ba dan phyar: rtsa rgyus drwa ba rgyu ma'i phreng long mdzes: tsit+ta'i pho long zhing gi g.yang gzhi bres: thod pa'i tshangs khang spyi gtsug phyur bu'i tog: bde drod me dpung 'khrigs pa'i dkyil yangs nas: rnam shes 'dab brgyad brdal ba'i gdan steng du: thabs dang shes rab nyi zla ge sar steng: lha bskyed pa: shes rig rgyal po dpal chen he ru ka: snang ba'i ngo bo pad+ma badz+ra rtsal: stong pa'i bdag nyid lha lcam gsang ba'i yum: gnyis med 'khril sbyor bde stong lhan cig rol: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru shrī pad+ma badz+ra hrī: dhu ma gha ye dhā ki nī na maḥswā hā: hrī: thabs shes yab yum bde rol cho 'phrul las: cir yang sprul pa'i lha tshogs bsam mi khyab:

zhi dang khro tshul rnam 'gyur brjod 'das kyang: rang snang blo yis mos pas gang 'dod gsal: hrī: nyon mongs tshar gcod khro rgyal 'bar ba dang: thugs rjes 'gro 'dul zhi tshul mdzes pa'i sku: yab yum sras 'khor bka' nyan bcas pa ste: gdangs gsal ma 'gag rol pa'i tshul bzhin bskyed: hrī: phyogs dang phyogs mtshams pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng: bud+dha thod phreng yab yum sras dang 'khor: mi bskyod rdo rje yab yum sras dang 'khor: pad+ma dbang chen yab yum sras dang 'khor: rig 'dzin thod rtsal yab yum sras dang 'khor: mdog dmar me phreng yab yum sras dang 'khor: sangs rgyas dpa' bo yab yum sras dang 'khor: dpal chen rta mgrin yab yum sras dang 'khor: lag na rdo rje yab yum sras dang 'khor: kun kyang sprul dang yang sprul bka' nyan tshogs: sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur du ma ste: gcig tu ma nges cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston: snang stong ma 'gag lhan ne lhang nger gsal: bud+dha thod phreng rtsal bai ro tsa na ā+oṃ: sarba bud+dha dhā ki nī hūm̐: ak+ṣo bh+yaḥbadz+ra su kha dha ri hūm̐: pad+me bha sha ha: dhā ki nī ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā: a tsar+ya ma hā badz+ra shān+ti pad+ma ku ru ti bh+yo dhā ki nī hūm̐: artsig nirtsig ma ma ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: bud+dha ka pā la dpa' bo hūm̐: bud+dhi pra dhā ki nī ma ma ru lu swā hā: badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa ma ma e ka dzā ṭī hūm̐: badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā kro dha ma ma sid+dhi hūm̐: hrī: stod smad bar khyams ba spu'i grong khyer du: dpa' bo dpa' mo la sogs dpag med kyang: rnam 'gyur cha lugs cir yang ston byed cing: ma 'gag lhun grub rol pa'i tshul du gsal: ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung thugs rje ma 'gag rol pa'i sku: spyan 'dren bzhugs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang: thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos skur dag pa las: rtsal snang dbyings nas rol cing gshegs su gsol:

rnam dag o rgyan bkod pa'i pho brang nas: pad+ma badz+ra 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: shar phyogs pho brang ri bo ta la nas: bud+dha thod phreng 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs gyad mkhar brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas: mi bskyod rdo rje 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: nub phyogs so sa gling gi pho brang nas: pad+ma dbang chen 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: byang phyogs ma ga dhā yi pho brang nas: thod pa rtsal chen 'khor bcas gshegs= shar lho bsil ba tshal gyi pho brang nas: drag po me phreng 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: lho nub dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas: dpa' bo thod dum 'khor bcas gshegs= nub byang rab tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod nas: dpa' bo rta mgrin 'khor bcas gshegs= byang shar lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: lag na rdo rje 'khor bcas gshegs= kun kyang ma 'gag cho 'phrul spyod pa'i tshul: gang la gang 'dul phrin las sna tshogs bdag: cho 'phrul du mar rol cing gshegs su gsol: 'khor gyi dhā ki shugs 'gro'i tshogs rnams kun: don gyi dbyings las lhun grub gcig mod kyang: gnas skabs yul don bran gyi tshul snang zhing: mthu stobs rtsal ldan nus pa'i shugs dang bcas: bdag sogs mos pa'i bu la rab dgongs nas: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: thugs rje brtse bas gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang: dkyil 'khor chen po'i lus la byin chen phob: sgrub mchog mched lcam ngag la dbang zhig skur: brgyud 'dzin mos pa'i sems la byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya: e ā ral+li hrīng hrīng: pheṃ pheṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: sgyu lus pho brang bkod pa'i gzhal yas 'dir: bzhugs pa'i dur khrod lhun grub nyams re dga': pho brang rin chen dam pa byin re chags:

dbang chen pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdangs dang ldan: thabs shes nyi zla brtsegs pa'i 'od zer 'phro: rang rang bzhugs pa'i gdan khri yangs pa'i steng: lha rnams dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: thugs rje'i 'phro 'du rol pa gtan la phob: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī: tsit+ta badz+ra dz+nyā na pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ: dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: rigs mchog dag pa 'od dpag med pa'i sku: rgyal tshab dam par dbang mdzad bcom ldan 'das: rigs lnga yum lnga'i tshogs dang bcas rnams kyis: byin rlabs dbang bskur dam pa deng 'dir stsol: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ: rgyas gdab pa ni: hrī: lhun grub rgyal ba dam tshig sems dpa'i sku: thugs rje'i sprul pa ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs: gdod nas gnyis med brdal ba'i klong yangs su: chu la chu bzhag lta bur e ma ho: ma dag ltar snang gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i blos: phan tshun so sor mtshan ma rang dgar bzung: deng nas dbyer med du ma ro gcig tu: don gyi dbyings su 'da' bar mi bgyid do: ā+oṃ ma hā shū dz+nyā tā sa ma ya hūm̐: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ra ho haṃ: phyag 'tshal ba ni: e ma ho: chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med cing: longs sku gsal stong ma 'dres so sor gsal: sprul sku gang la ci 'dul phrin las bdag: sku gsum bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: longs sku khro tshul log 'dren gdug pa 'dul: sprul sku rnam 'gyur du ma'i cha lugs can: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo: chos sku stong nyid dpa' mo yum gyi mkha': longs sku bde chen dpa' bo yab kyi dbyings: bde stong mkha' dbyings 'khor bcas sprul pa'i tshogs: cho 'phrul sras bcas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: na mo gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī: dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirmā kā ya: a ti pu ho: pra tī dza ho: phyi mchod 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐ hrī: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: me tog bdug spos mar me zhal zas dri: sgra dbyangs ar+ghaṃ la sogs mchod pa'i sprin: phyi mchod rnam dag rgyal ba rnams la 'bul: nang mchod: lha mi'i mchod rdzas 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa'i: rang byung nang mchod kun bzang sprin phung ltar: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: gsang mchod: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal che: phrag dog sha khrag rgyus pa nang rol te: tsit+tar bcas rnams dug lnga phung po'i rdzas: gsang mchod rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni: yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang rol pa las: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi bcud 'phro zhing: bde stong lhan cig skyes sbyor mnyam gnas pa: bla med mchod pa rang snang lha la 'bul: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wi d+yā shab+da pū dza ho: rū pa shab+da ghan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza ho: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta ki ni ri ti ba su ta tsit+ta pū dza ho: bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha pū dza ho:

bdud rtsi sman mchod: hrī: bhan+dha khor yug yangs pa'i snod chen por: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis sbyor bdud rtsi mchog: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i rdzas: rgyu drug rkyen bzhi bdud rtsi ra sā ya: rang byung 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas dgyes mchod 'bul: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: thugs rje'i rtsal snang dkyil 'khor lha rnams la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas dgyes mchod 'bul: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: ma 'gag sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas dgyes mchod 'bul: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: mos pa'i blos bzung dkyil 'khor lha rnams la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas dgyes mchod 'bul: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: 'dus byas ltar snang dkyil 'khor lha rnams la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas dgyes mchod 'bul: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: dam tshig gnyan gyi srung ma thams cad la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas dgyes mchod 'bul: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: 'khor 'das lha dang 'gro ba thams cad la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas dgyes mchod 'bul: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: rak+ta 'bul ba ni: hrī: dung chen snod du dmar chen rba rlabs 'phyo: rten 'brel bcu gnyis rak+ta'i ba gam 'khrigs: gu h+ya mū la rak+tar bcas pa rnams: bkram pa'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐ hrī: dbyings rig ma bu'i byur 'dre rab bsgral te: gnyis snang rtog pa'i bcud chen gtor mar sbyar: 'phro 'du'i rlangs las sna tshogs rgyu rkyen 'dus: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag 'od zer 'phro: kha mngar skyur rtsub ro bcud nus par ldan: tshogs drug yul snang gtor ma brjid ldan 'di:

cho 'phrul du mas bsregs sbyangs bkrus shing bsgyur: rnam dag bdud rtsi'i zhal zas chen po ste: ye shes rab 'byams mchod pa chen po'i rdzas: byin rlabs mkhyen ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang: rang snang rnam dag yi dam lha yi tshogs: sprul pas 'gro 'dul mkha' 'gro chos skyong la: mchod par 'bul gyis blang dor med par bzhes: 'dus byas rdzas sbyar snod bcud phun sum tshogs: tshogs gnyis spel phyir rgyu rkyen gtor ma 'di: mdzes pa'i dkar thig dmar gur bdud rtsis brlan: sna tshogs cod pan lding gur brjid ldan phub: 'dod yon longs spyod bza' btung bran pa 'di: bla ma rnams dang yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dpa' bo dpa' mo dam can chos skyong dang: mchod 'os bka' sdod srung mar bcas la 'bul: thugs rje thugs dam dbang gis bzhes su gsol: dgyes shing rol pa chen por bzhes nas kyang: bdag gzhan 'gro bas ji ltar 'dod pa yi: don 'bras myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba la: hūm̐ hrī: thugs rje'i rol pa dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las bdag: 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal mgon o rgyan rje: pad+ma badz+ra rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: don gyi dbyings la cha lugs mi mnga' yang: gdul bya mos blo'i snang tshul ji bzhin du: rnam 'gyur du mas phrin las gzhan don mdzad: rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi 'dor thabs tshul: dmar mthing dkar dang zhi khro phyed ma'i zhal: g.yas gsum rdo rje ral gri bdud rtsi bum: dril bu ban+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon gsum phyag: gnyis med bde sbyor lha lcam gsang ba'i yum: dmar mo ḍā ru dung dmar g.yas g.yon 'khyud: yab yum gnyis med rus rgyan dur khrod chas: gar dgu'i nyams ldan sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

yab yum bde rol 'bar 'dzag 'phros pa las: gzugs sku'i lha tshogs rnam 'phrul du ma shar: gtso 'khor yab yum sras kyi tshul ston cing: sprul sgyur sna tshogs 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhud+dha thod phreng dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal: 'khor lo rdo rje rtse dgu zhing dbyug g.yas: bum pa dril bu zhags pa g.yon gsum phyag: dbyings phyug sngon mo rgyal mtshan dung dmar 'khyud: yab yum gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal bstod: mi bskyod rdo rje ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal: g.yas gsum ral gri mdung thung thod dbyug phyar: stong gi 'jig rten me rlung g.yon gsum phyag: bde dbyings dmar ser chos 'byung dung dmar stob: yab yum gnyis med 'khril la phyag 'tshal bstod: pad+ma dbang chen dkar dmar mthing ba'i zhal: g.yas gsum phreng ba rnga yab lcags kyu 'dzin: pad sdong gwa 'u dbang zhags g.yon gsum phyag: rig byed dmar skya ḍā ru thod khrag stob: yab yum gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal bstod: rig 'dzin thod rtsal ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal: 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri g.yas gsum phyag: g.yon gsum dril bu zhags pa phur bu 'dzin: nyi zla dmar mo thod phreng ga 'u stob: yab yum gnyis med 'khril la phyag 'tshal bstod: mdog dmar me phreng g.yas dkar g.yon ljang zhal: rdo rje rtse lnga tho lum me dpung g.yas: thod khrag sdig pa bam chen g.yon gsum phyag: srid pa dmar mo tho ba bhan+dha 'khyud: yab yum gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal bstod: sangs rgyas dpa' bo mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal: 'khor lo zla ba me dpung g.yas gsum phyag: g.yon gsum gshol mda' nyi ma rlung nag bsnams: dpa' mo dkar mo 'khor lo bdud rtsi stob: yab yum gnyis med 'khril la phyag 'tshal bstod: rta mgrin dmar po dkar dang sngo ba'i zhal: g.yas gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje sbrul zhags 'dzin: thod khrag dril bu lcags sgrog g.yon gsum phyag: tsa ti smug nag tri shul dung dmar stob:

yab yum gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal lo: lag na rdo rje mthing nag dkar dmar zhal: rdo rje gri gug sbrul zhags g.yas gsum phyag: g.yon gsum thod khrag dril bu pad+ma bsnams: gsang dbyings dmar mo kha ṭ+wāṃ bhan dmar stob: yab yum gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal bstod: kun kyang yab yum rus rgyan dur khrod chas: yab rnams zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs bdud bzhi mnan: yum rnams dpal chen yab kyi sked la 'khyud: zhi dang khro gar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang gzhan gsum lha dang lha mo'i tshogs: byed pa kun ston rnam 'phrul yongs kyi mdzod: 'khor 'das rang grol bde chen g.yung drung sku: dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi yo byad ni: bza' btung bca' sogs 'byor ldan bshams nas kyang: rdo rje dang bcas bdud rtsi'i zer gtor te: ā+oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kun+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: kyis bsang sbyang: ho: zhal zas tshogs la nyes pa ma mchis kyang: bshams pa'i rdzas kyi 'bag btsog dri ma rnams: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsreg gtor sbyang byas shing: nyes pa'i skyon bral legs pa'i yon tan ldan: raṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: yaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: khaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: byin brlabs: ā+oṃ las 'od 'phros dbyings dang mnyam par spel: āḥlas 'od 'phros rtog tshogs 'khrul pa sbyangs: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: ha las 'od 'phros 'dod yon snang srid bkang: hoḥlas 'od 'phros lha rnams dgyes pa bskangs: hrīḥlas 'od 'phros mgron rnams tshim zhing ngoms: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: tshogs kyi yo byad gzhung bzhin bshams nas kyang: bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs ro bcud nus par ldan: sgrub rdzas gnyan po'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bul:

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam gnyan bskangs te: sgrub mchog bu la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: bstab pa bya ba ni: hrīḥ bstab bo bstab bo lha tshogs zhal du bstab: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro zhal phyes shig: chos skyong dam can srung ma zhal phyes shig: ston pa rdo rje rgyal po zhal phyes shig: gzung ma kun tu bzang mo zhal phyes shig: 'dus pa'i mched dang lcam dral zhal phyes shig: gnod byed gzugs phung sha khrag zhal du bstab: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: tshogs phud mchod: rol cig rol cig 'dod yon tshogs la rol: zhal zas rol pa tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: tshogs bshags: ho: bdag sogs ma rig lus ngag yid gsum gyis: bag med spyod pas dam las 'gal gyur te: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas mthol bshags na: dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul sor chud de: sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra satwa sa ma ya: zhes tshang bar brjod: skong gso ni: hūm̐ hrī: bskang ngo gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang: 'dod yon longs spyod rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang: bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang: sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol: sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor: ye sgrol ye sbyor chen pos thugs dam bskang: lta ba klong du gyur pas thugs dam bskang: sgom pa yengs 'khrul rkyen dang bral bas bskang: spyod pa blang dor tshul 'chos bral bas bskang: 'bras bu lhun grub phyogs lhung med pas bskang: bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: dam can chos skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyi thugs dam bskang:

'dus pa'i mched lcam rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: rigs drug pha ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ces pas dang po lha rnams mchod nas kyang: bar du 'dus pa rgya mtshos rol byas te: thog mar rdo rje slob dpon 'di skad mchod: ho: rdo rje rgyal po yab yum dgongs su gsol: nyes pa'i skyon bral 'dod yon longs spyod rdzas: bla med dgyes mchod tshogs kyi zhal zas 'di: 'gro ba'i don phyir blang dor med par bzhes: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: zhes pas phyag rgya pad skor ldan pas drang: ston pas dgyes pa'i tshul gyis 'di skad blang: e ma ho: gdod nas rnam dag zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud: 'dod yon ma spangs rang dag chags bral rkyen: yid bzhin gter mchog bla med khyad par che: 'gro ba'i don phyir bdag gis blangs te rol: a hoḥm hā su kha: de nas rim bzhin mched lcam rnams la drang: dgongs shig rol cig mched lcam rnal 'byor rnams: bla med theg pa mchog gi zhal zas 'di: gnyis mnyam dgag sgrub blang dor med tshul gyis: rang bzhin gcig pa'i dbyings su da rol cig: 'dus pa rgya mtshos 'di skad brda yis blang: e ma ho: skye 'gag gnas gsum mtha' bral don gyi dbyings: cho 'phrul ga ṇa'i rten 'brel tshul dang ldan: lhan cig skyes sbyor zab mo gsang mchog rdzas: du ma ro gcig ngang du blang bar bgyi'o: gu h+ya sid+dhi a la la ho: tshogs lhag yongs bsdus gtso bo'i zhal chab bran: bdud rtsir byin brlabs 'di skad phul te gshegs: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: bla med don gyi cho ga brtsams nas kyang: rol pa tshogs kyi yo byad rab bshams te: dang po phud kyis dkyil 'khor lha rnams mchod: bar du tshogs kyis 'dus pa rgya mtsho bskangs: tha ma phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin brlabs nas:

sgyu lus bkod pa'i grong khyer la gnas pa'i: dpal gyi bka' nyan dam tshig grogs mdzad ma: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i las byed tshogs la 'bul: dang por phud la dbang ba phud la rol: bar du tshogs la dgyes pa tshogs la rol: tha ma lhag la dbang ba lhag ma longs: dpal gyi bka' 'bab lhag ma'i longs spyod 'di: gang gis dbang ba thams cad tshims nas kyang: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i las mdzod cig: ā+oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā: skabs 'dir lhar gsal 'dzab bsnyen dag la 'bad: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī swā hā: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hriḥya a tri nṛ dzaḥ sarba aṅgu sha tsit+ta hrīng hrīng sarba ba su sid+dhi ku ru swā hā: zhes dang gzhan yang ci ltar 'dod pa yi: lha bsnyen la sogs rang rang gzhung bzhin bzla: dmigs pa'i spro bsdu gang rigs kha bsgyur 'bad: gtor mar sman raka sbreng zhing gzi byin bskyed: rol mo dang bcas lha rnams 'di ltar bskul: hūm̐ hrī: chos sku skye med zhi ba'i ngang nyid las: longs sku mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing: sprul sku cir yang 'gyur ba'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam dbyings nas bzhengs te sku bskyod 'tshal: bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam gnad nas bskul: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: mdzod cig mdzod cig mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: bar chad dgra bgegs ru dra rdul du rlog: bla ma yi dam dhā ki'i tshogs bcas rnams: zhal zas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: mthun rkyen bsgrub cing 'gal rkyen bzlog pa dang: phrin las rnam bzhi myur du 'grub par mdzod: bka' srung pho nya las byed chos skyong tshogs: g.yog dang yang g.yog sprul par bcas pa rnams: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: za ba'i 'dre dang phung ba'i sri rnams kun: skad cig yud tsam gyis ni med par mdzod:

gang zhig bla ma la sdang spun la 'khu: 'gro la gnod cing bstan pa'i dgra bo rnams: sha zo khrag 'thungs bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal te: phrag dog la sogs nyon mongs dbyings su sgrol: 'khu 'phrig gnyis 'dzin nyes tshogs nyam nga ba: thar pa'i gegs byed bar chad rdul du rlog: mthun rkyen bsgrub cing 'gal rkyen bzlog pa dang: bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: skabs 'dir mched dang lcam dral thams cad kyang: bro gar la sogs rol rtsed sna tshogs dang: nyams bskyang brtul zhugs spyod pa thogs med bya: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i: phrin las kha bsgyur gang 'dod brtsam bya zhing: kha skong dang bcas rang rang gzhung nas btsal: ji ltar 'dod rnams rnal 'byor brtson par bya: gtor ma phyir dpag bdud rtsi rak+ta bran: sngon gyi tha tshig chad mdo 'di ltar gyer: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: rang bzhin lhun grub chos dbyings pho brang du: thog ma'i mgon po ston pa kun bzang gis: rang byung 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: sprul pa tshogs drug dhā ki shugs 'gro yis: so so'i yul snang rang gzugs bstan nas kyang: cir snang gtor ma len par ma chad dam: 'gyur med bstan pa srung bar ma chad dam: dug lnga'i dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam: sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: rang bzhin dag pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la: ting 'dzin ston pa yengs med rgyal po yis: bag yod shes bzhin dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: 'gyu byed phra rags lha srin sde brgyad kyis: so so'i sgrib g.yogs med par gzugs bstan nas: rang grol gtor ma len par ma chad dam: 'byams yug bstan pa srung bar ma chad dam: rnam rtog rkun bu bsgral bar ma chad dam:

brjed ngas ther la 'don par ma chad dam: sngon gyi chad don tha tshig rjes dgongs la: cir snang rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa snyigs ma la: rgyu rkyen las 'das pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: glo bur ltar snang rje 'bangs grogs bcas kyis: mos pa'i blos bzung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: kun rdzob mtshan ma'i bka' srung thams cad kyis: rnam rtog yid kyi rang gzugs bstan nas kyang: yid dpyod gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rang babs bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnam g.yengs dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: ye shes bcud ldan gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: da dus deng sang bskal pa'i snyigs ma la: skye rga na 'chi 'gyur ba'i pho brang du: long med brtson 'grus sngags 'chang bdag cag gis: skyo shas mos gus dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: kun rdzob ltar snang 'dus byas lha 'dre yis: mngon sum mi rtag rang gzugs bstan nas kyang: 'khrul snang gtor ma len par ma chad dam: gnyan po'i bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: bslu brid dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: dran snang so ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

gtor gzhong bshal chus brtan ma bskyang ba ni: bh+yo:brtan ma skyong mdzad ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs: phyi nang gzhan sogs bka' yi bya ra ba: dam tshig gnyan gyi grogs mdzad dhā ki rnams: sprul dang yang sprul bran dang bcas rnams kyang: rnam 'gyur cha lugs cir yang ston byed cing: las su sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung: zas dang skom du sha dang khrag la dgyes: 'dir gshegs rdzas kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bka' dang bstan pa yun du srung ba dang: 'khor dang gang zag rtag tu skyong ba dang: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod cig: bstan skyong srung ma rnams kyis rtag tu skyongs: gnod byed 'gugs gzhug byas te gtor gzhong sbub: gtor gzhong ri rab mnan dmigs rta bro brdung: hūm̐ hrī: bla ma'i byin rlabs yi dam ting 'dzin dang: mkha' 'gro'i mthu rtsal mched lcam rdzu 'phrul gyis: gnod byed bdud dang dgra bgegs ru dra'i tshogs: nyon mongs la sogs thar pa'i gegs byed rnams: pho brang ri rab chen po'i 'og tu mnan: steng du khro rgyal brtul zhugs bro brdungs pas: bla med byang chub mchog sems ma skyes bar: mnan pa yin gyis ldang bar ma byed cig: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ staṃ bha ya mā ra ya nan: nang log dngos grub rdzas rnams lag tu thogs: dkyil 'khor bskor zhing dngos grub stsol dmigs la: hūm̐ hrī: bde chen yangs pa chen po'i pho brang nas: byin rlabs mchog stsol bla ma chos kyi sku: ji ltar 'dod 'byung yid bzhin gter gyi mdzod: byin rlabs smin grol dngos grub bstsal du gsol: snang la ma 'gag cir snang gzhal yas nas: dngos grub kun ster yi dam longs spyod rdzogs: zhi dang khro tshul dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mthu stobs nus pa mthar phyin pho brang nas: phrin las mnga' bdag dhā ki sprul pa'i sku: rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston cing bya ra byed:

rnam bzhi'i las kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: yongs kyi gtso mchog o rgyan thod phreng rtsal: khyod la rtse gcig gus pas gsol 'debs kyis: bla med mchog dang thun mong yid bzhin sogs: dngos grub dam pa deng 'dir bstsal du gsol: 'chi med tshe dang zas nor longs spyod sogs: gnas skabs bde skyid dngos grub bstsal du gsol: skye 'gag gnas gsum mtha' bral sku gsung thugs: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje yangs pa'i klong: lus ngag yid gsum smin grol sa la sbyor: yang dag don 'bras bcud kyi dngos grub stsol: dngos grub stsal dang stsol bar mi dmigs kyang: khyed dang bdag gnyis g.yar dam gcig pa'i gnad: 'gro la phan phyir bdag gis stsol bgyid na: dam tshig dbang gis ci 'dod dngos grub stsol: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la a la la ho: zhes pas dngos grub rdzas rnams longs spyod do: de nas nyes byas bshags pa 'di skad do: kye kye: dus gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: thugs rje brtse bas breng tsam bdag la dgongs: blo nor blun rmongs 'khrul pa bdag 'dra yis: dad gdung gus pas lha mchog bsgrub slad du: phrin las cho ga'i tshul 'di brtsams lags kyang: ma rig sgrib pas nyes ltung phog gyur na: ye shes lha la gtsang sme mi mnga' yang: khyed kyi 'bangs su gyur pa'i srung ma rnams: g.yel bar gyur pa'i las bgyis bzod par gsol: nyes ltung sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams mthol zhing bshags: phyin chad bdag la nongs par ma gyur cig: ces sogs gzhan yang yi ge brgya pa yis: lhag chad kha bskang bshags pa gang 'thad bya: me tog 'thor zhing 'di skad shis pa brjod: hūm̐ hrī: rgyal ba'i sku ni ri rgyal lhun po ltar: gzi brjid lhun chags bdud dpung zil gyis gnon: blta bas mi ngoms 'gyur med rdo rje ste: yid bzhin nor mchog sku yi bkra shis shog: rgyal ba'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs ltar:

'ur ting sing khrol chos dbyangs 'brug sgra sgrog: 'gro rnams dbyangs chen bdud rtsis ngoms par mdzad: rang byung 'gags med gsung gi bkra shis shog: rgyal ba'i thugs ni rkyen bral nam mkha' ltar: kun khyab bde gsal mi rtog thugs rje can: 'gro rnams yal bar mi 'dor bu bzhin skyong: mkhyen brtse ye shes thugs kyi bkra shis shog: rgyal ba rnams kyi yon tan dpag yas shing: 'khor 'das dbyer med lhun 'byams yongs la mnga': gting zab yangs pa bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'beb: yon tan mi zad mchog gi bkra shis shog: rgyal ba'i phrin las yongs la mnga' brnyes pas: thabs dang shes rab mdzad pa du ma yi: mthu stobs rtsal gyis 'gro ba sgrol bar mdzad: phrin las mthar phyin bkra shis yongs khyab shog: ༈ snod bcud skye 'gro lha dang bcas pa rnams: sgyu lus gzhal yas khang du gsal la bsdu: de yang shes rig lha tshogs bskyed la ste: de yang 'khor rnams gtso bo yab yum la: yum nyid yab la yab kyang sa bon la: sa bon bar snang 'ja' 'am chu bur ltar: dmigs med rgyas gdab gang shar 'phro 'du rnams: rang gar ngang bzhag bcos bslad mi bya bar: chad med rgya yan cog bzhag lhug par bor: rang lugs babs gnas dbyings rig ma bu 'dres: gdod ma'i sangs rgyas nyid dang mjal bar gyur: de lta'i tshul 'di rnal 'byor rgyal pos blta: mchod gtor la sogs yo byad dkyil 'khor rnams: dngos grub blang dang gshegs pa gang 'thad bya: las rjes mi mngon yang na gang mdzes te: rjes kyi tshul lugs rnal 'byor nyams dang sbyar: de las byung dang gzhan yang dge ba'i rgyun: byas dang byed 'gyur gzhan la yi rang ste: bdag gzhan dge rtsa theg chen sar bsngos la: 'khor gsum dmigs med ngang la gnas par bya: chos kyi dbyings kyi ngang las rgyun byung ba: dmigs bcas dmigs med zung 'jug dge ba'i las: 'dis mtshon bdag gzhan byas byed yi rang sogs: bla med theg pa chen por bsngo bar bgyi:

bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba ma lus kun: dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas ni: tshe rabs las kyi sdig sgrib yongs byang nas: zab yangs chos mdzod klong du grol bar shog: ces pa la sogs bsngo ba smon lam rigs: ji ltar 'dod bzhin mched lcam rnams kyis bya: gzhan yang rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'di ltar phrin las rim pa ni: lus dkyil nyid dang 'brel ba ste: rgyas bsdus long khyab tshul dang bstun: bdag bskyed lha yi rnal 'byor dang: mdun du'ang sku gzugs dkyil 'khor sogs: dmigs rten gang 'thad bkram bya zhing: mchod gtor la sogs tshul bzhin bsham: cho ga gzhan dang 'brel na yang: rang gzhung tshul la cho ga 'di: lhag chad med par brtsams gyur na: byin rlabs dngos grub la sogs pa: rnal 'byor ji ltar bsam bzhin 'grub: 'di ni kun gyi kha skong ste: mdor bsdus pad+ma badz+ras bkod: las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: sbas rgya: gter rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: phrin las lam khyer bsdus pa me tog phreng mdzes zhes bya ba: mchims phu bre gu'i dge'ur slob dpon chen po pad+mas mdzad pa la: phyi rabs kyi rnal 'byor don ched du mtsho rgyal bdag gis zin bris su btab nas dbus ri nag po'i ltong:o rgyan gyi sgrub gnas pu ri phug chen du rgya rim pa dgus bsdams nas gter du sbas pa'o: sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pa gar gyi dbang phyug rol pa ye shes rtsal gyis gter nas gdan drangs pa lags so/// /
